questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw cocoa beans are imported by all chocolate manufacturing companies in Switzerland in a single year?
reasoning: Switzerland produces vast amounts of chocolate for global consumption
An estimated 150,000 tonnes of cocoa beans are imported annually to meet this demand
Converting tonnes to kilograms yields 150 million kilograms

questions.prompt: How many total individual piano keys are pressed across all pianos played by students taking formal music examinations in the United Kingdom in a single year?
reasoning: Around 600,000 students take formal practical piano exams each year in the UK
Each student practices an average of 150 keys per minute during preparation and exams over months
Multiplying examinees by estimated practice strokes totals about 1.8 billion key presses

questions.prompt: How many total individual pages of paper are contained within all passport booklets held by active citizens of New Zealand?
reasoning: New Zealand has a population of approximately 5 million people, with around 3 million holding valid passports
A standard New Zealand passport contains roughly 36 pages
Multiplying total passport holders by pages per booklet yields 108 million pages
